comment: What sdk/build-mod.bat and sdk/build-mod.sh download, once, into sdk/toolchain/. The launchers carry the same URLs and hashes in plain text (a batch file cannot read JSON); tools/pc/test_sdk_launchers.py keeps the three in step, and test_build_mod_toolchain.py keeps this file in step with the toolchain the game is built with.

python.comment: Windows only: the embeddable CPython (python.org). Linux uses the system python3. The hash is the one python.org publishes beside the file (python-3.14.8-embed-amd64.zip.spdx.json).
